## What it catches

App code outside layer folders.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "app-code-in-layers",
  "severity": "error",
  "module": {
    "path": "^apps/[^/]+/src/",
    "pathNot": [
      "^apps/[^/]+/src/(?:delivery|server|use-cases)/",
      "^apps/[^/]+/src/(?:main[.]ts|index[.]ts)$",
      "(?:^|/)(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)|[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$"
    ],
    "numberOfDependentsLessThan": 100
  },
  "from": {}
}
```
